description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Memnite.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {W}.
When Memnite dies, Koll triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.
